official.title: Season 21 Abilities Tuning Preview
official.evidence: Official preview confirms a proximity-detonation bug and secondary arming-shape fix. Historical total PvP damage changed from 150 to 135.
official.short_quote: Fixed an issue preventing the secondary projectile arming shape from activating.
official.limit: Historical evidence of proximity detonation; no current numerical radius, arming distance, shape or speed is published here.

unresolved: Guardian 27? per spark and 135? total explicitly retain the source question marks.
Range, blast radius, fan angle, speed, gravity, tracking and proximity arming geometry remain uncalibrated.
Generic spherical proximity and distance arming are Chorus capabilities, not claims about the original secondary arming shape.

Five physical sparks, explosions, shared Scorch / Ignition and Sunbracers now have reference composition; production loadout assembly, all interactions, original-game calibration and physical entity restart remain incomplete.

implementation.host_dependency: Enroll solar_scaling with the managed ActorBinding owner root, independent of melee and other ability selections; configuration and source projection restore together.
scope: Single paid melee use launches five independent physical sparks using captured look / yaw axes.
Entity, block, range and proximity detonation query actual recipients; confirmed positive nonlethal damage requests shared Scorch.
Scorch / Ignition preserve original melee ability credit; direct and Scorch kills can arm Sunbracers, followed by paid Solar Grenade uses.
Direct melee bonus does not apply again to derived Scorch / Ignition damage.
limits: Test resources are reference definitions, excluded from release jars.
Guardian damage 27, geometry, speed, falloff, timing and world-unit projection are explicit test inputs.
Tracking / aim assistance and Song of Flame variant are not assembled.
Physical flight entities are not restored across process restart.
